## `#[AsComponent]`

`Semitexa\Ssr\Attribute\AsComponent`

Applies to: class

| parameter | type | required |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | `string` | yes |
| `template` | `string` | no |
| `layout` | `string` | no |
| `cacheable` | `bool` | no |
| `event` | `string` | no |
| `triggers` | `array` | no |
| `script` | `string` | no |

```php
#[AsComponent(
    name: 'disclosure-prompt',
    template: '@shop/components/disclosure-prompt.html.twig',
    event: DemoDisclosureExpanded::class,
    triggers: ['click'],
)]
final class DisclosurePromptComponent
```
